context: Naoko and Yumiko discuss a famous athlete retiring.
purpose: Two older women discussing news naturally.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: お姉さん、あの選手、引退するんやって!
lines.style: animated Kansai aunt voice, bright warm surprised delivery carefully

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: まあ、近年、ずっと活躍してたのにね。
lines.en: Oh, and they've been so active these recent years.
lines.style: gentle older mother voice, soft warm reflective delivery carefully

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.style: soft Kansai aunt voice, warm honest delivery carefully

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: でも、ようけ頑張ったわね。
lines.en: But they gave it their all.
lines.style: tender older mother voice, soft warm fond delivery carefully

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: 次の人生も、応援したいわ。
lines.en: I want to root for their next chapter too.
lines.style: warm Kansai aunt voice, soft warm supportive delivery carefully

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: そうね、お疲れさまって、言いたい。
lines.en: Yes — I'd like to say 'well done.'
lines.style: soft older mother voice, warm warm appreciative delivery carefully
